items.t: Airbag light on from water in crash sensor (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Steering wheel emblem can break apart when airbag deploys (recall)
items.job: Replace steering wheel emblem or airbag cover
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Sudden loss of power steering assist (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Check engine light from a rubbed-through air/fuel sensor wire
items.job: Repair sensor wiring or replace air/fuel sensor
items.note: A wiring repair alone costs less than a new sensor.

items.t: Worn or broken engine mounts
items.job: Replace worn engine or transmission mount
items.note: Price is per mount. Some cars need two or three.

items.t: Sticky, shiny dashboard top
items.note: Ask a Mazda dealer about goodwill help. A dash cover costs far less.

items.t: Early clutch wear on manual cars
items.note: Add a flywheel if it is worn, which raises the cost.

items.t: Driver seat rocks back and forth (recall)
items.job: Repair or replace driver seat recliner hardware
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Hatch struts can corrode and let the liftgate drop (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Oil leak and rattle from the drive belt tensioner
items.job: Replace drive belt tensioner and belt

items.t: Mazda Connect screen ghost touches, freezes or reboots
items.note: Mazda extended screen coverage and settled a class action. Check your VIN with a dealer first.

items.t: No-start, battery drain or odd electrical faults linked to accessories
items.job: Diagnose drain and remove or rewire the accessory
items.note: Add a new battery if the old one was run down too often.

items.t: Alternator belt can slip in heavy rain (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Parking brake can rust and stick (recall)
items.job: Replace rear caliper with parking brake mechanism
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer. Price is per side.

items.t: Fuel tank weld can leak (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Fuel shut-off valve can cause leak or stall (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Backup camera picture flickers or distorts (recall)
items.job: Replace rear camera or camera harness
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Wrong exhaust valve spring can stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN. Cost rises a lot if the valves or engine were damaged.

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Automatic emergency braking activates for no reason (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Engine may stall while driving (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Lug nuts can loosen (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Front head restraint may not lock in place (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer. Price is per seat.

items.t: Check engine light from cylinder deactivation fault
items.job: Update engine software and inspect valve train
items.note: Often a dealer warranty repair on newer cars. Damaged valve train parts raise the cost.

items.t: Front brake caliper bolts may loosen (recall)
items.job: Retighten or replace front caliper bolts
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Tire valve stems can suddenly leak (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Backup camera image may not appear (recall)
items.job: Update or replace rear camera system
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Forward camera fault disables emergency braking (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Airbag sensor can switch off the airbags (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Turbo engine burns oil between services
items.note: Covered for many owners by a Mazda oil consumption program and a class settlement; ask the dealer about coverage.
